assertions.name: multiterm_t4_cannot_rescue_l6a4
assertions.source: T1+T4 offset leaves a 4.88 MeV gap, so L6a4 loses to higher-|tr_M| braids.

description: Refutes the hypothesis that wiring the T4 Frobenius offset into the SDP cost makes He3's historical L6a4 the winner. L6a4's T1+T4 binding prediction is 2.83 MeV, far short of the 7.718 MeV B_AME. Other candidates hit 4.6 MeV and win on relative residual.
